The side margins get tight around 'silence.' and the quiet, airy minimalism of the original is gone, which goes against the message itself. B keeps the original's two-line wrap and scale, but the block sits well below centre (its middle is at about y≈495 on a 768px canvas), with a large dead area above and a cramped bottom margin.
